description.zh: 从主题、文档或数据出发，策划故事线和逐页大纲，生成风格统一、带原生图表和讲稿备注的 .pptx；内置 5 套主题、13 种版式，自动检查文字溢出，也能读取和修改已有 PPT。
description.en: Plans a storyline and slide-by-slide outline from a topic, document, or data, then builds a consistent .pptx with native charts and speaker notes. Five themes, 13 layouts, automatic overflow checks, and editing for existing decks.

welcome_message.zh: 告诉我 PPT 的用途、受众和大致页数，或者直接把材料发给我
welcome_message.en: Tell me the purpose, audience, and rough length — or just send me the material

description.zh: 结论先行的季度/月度汇报

prompt.zh: 帮我做一份工作汇报 PPT。汇报对象：___；时间范围：___；主要内容和数据如下：
prompt.en: Create a work report deck. Audience: ___; period: ___; key content and data:

description.zh: 把长文档提炼成演示文稿
description.en: Condense a long document into a deck

prompt.zh: 请把我上传的文档提炼成一份 ___ 页左右的 PPT，受众是 ___，重点突出 ___。
prompt.en: Turn the document I uploaded into a deck of about ___ slides for ___, emphasizing ___.

prompt.zh: 帮我做一份方案提案 PPT：要解决的问题是 ___，我们的方案是 ___，需要争取的支持是 ___。
prompt.en: Create a proposal deck: the problem is ___, our solution is ___, and we need ___.

description.zh: 把表格数据做成图表页
description.en: Turn spreadsheet data into chart slides

prompt.zh: 把下面的数据做成几页图表 PPT，每页标题写出结论：
prompt.en: Turn the following data into a few chart slides, each with a conclusion-style title:

prompt.zh: 帮我做一份培训课件，主题：___，学员：___，时长约 ___ 分钟，需要带讲稿备注。
prompt.en: Create a training deck on ___ for ___, about ___ minutes, with speaker notes.

description.en: Fix text, reorder slides, add notes

prompt.zh: 我上传了一份 PPT，请帮我：___（例如：把 2025 改成 2026、删掉第 5 页、给每页补讲稿）。
prompt.en: I uploaded a deck. Please: ___ (e.g. change 2025 to 2026, delete slide 5, add notes to every slide).

zh: 每周五「16:00」根据本周工作记录生成周报 PPT 初稿，发给我确认
每月 1 日「10:00」用上月销售数据生成月度经营分析 PPT
每季度末最后一个工作日「15:00」整理季度复盘 PPT 大纲，先发大纲不生成文件
每周一「09:30」把上周例会纪要整理成 5 页以内的同步 PPT
每天「18:00」检查 inbound 目录新上传的 PPT，列出文字溢出和错别字问题
每月最后一个周五「17:00」汇总本月项目里程碑，生成时间轴页面
en: Every Friday at 16:00, draft a weekly report deck from this week's work log and send it for my review
On the 1st of each month at 10:00, build a monthly business review deck from last month's sales data
On the last weekday of each quarter at 15:00, prepare a quarterly retrospective outline — outline only, no file
Every Monday at 09:30, turn last week's meeting notes into a sync deck of at most 5 slides
Every day at 18:00, check newly uploaded decks in inbound and list overflow and typo issues
On the last Friday of each month at 17:00, summarize project milestones into a timeline slide
